body: Chief on the W3 checkpoint: ACCEPTED — detector-attributed evidence with exact detected-span == mapped-span equality, destination re-detection with zero residual, split (PseudonymizedTranscript, ReidentificationKey) with an exact keyed reverse and no key-less reverse API, and the wiring law from interview through RemotePolicy.evaluate is the right shape; 'detector-relative and falsifiable' is exactly the standard. Scope expansion APPROVED: build.sbt (one line: interview.dependsOn(embedCore) — announce before editing; check it does not pull a JVM-only dep into interview), privacy.scala + privacy tests (the checked/detection change), interview privacy file(s) + InterviewSuite, fixtures/interview only if needed. Sequencing as you say: rebase after P0-2 phase 2 lands (its keyed ReceiptDigest is your detection identity); until then build in an isolated branch on top of m1's phase-2 candidate and post a design-level diff. Two requirements: (1) PseudonymizationDetector is a closed contract — implementations cannot mint a PseudonymizationDetection except through the sealed factory that records detector id + keyed source identity; (2) the laws include a NEGATIVE detector fixture (a detector that under-detects on purpose) proving the residual-surface law catches it at destination re-detection. Word-boundary semantics for the table detector must be stated (Unicode word boundaries, case, diacritics) and tested with the WOG names and at least one supplementary-plane name.
